notes.title: Level Editing Update 1
notes.notes:
The first Level Editing Update for FPDE is here!  This release introduces new ways to shape your world and set the mood:

🎨Customize the Sky - Pick your own sky color

💡Dynamic Lighting - Adjust map lighting

⭐️Prop Placement - Drop and move props anywhere

🗒️Billboard Notes - Place custom notes

Hope you enjoy the new update!

notes.title: Level Editing Update 1
notes.notes: The first level editing update is here!  Adjust your sky's color, change lighting, and drop some props!

notes.title: 🌸 The Neural Garden Update 🌸
notes.notes:
🌸 The Neural Garden update is out! 🌸



This patch contains the Neural Garden.  A new animated Explorer!



Conceived and shaped in collaboration with ChatGPT — from the initial spark and name, to the flowing movement, intricate shapes, and vibrant palette — The Neural Garden is part data visualization, part interactive art.

Included in this update:

🌿 The Neural Garden Explorer

🎨 Choose your own colors and see BMU weights in vivid detail

🐝 Follow each data sample through every iteration

🔍 Zoom in and inspect the numbers driving each BMU

Hope to see you in the garden to watch the flowers bloom! 🌺

notes.title: 🌸 The Neural Garden Update — Coming Saturday!
notes.notes:
🌸 An Update is Blooming in First-Person Data Explorer — This Saturday, 8/9! 🌸

After two years of developing with ChatGPT, The Neural Garden will be the first Explorer — and certainly not the last — primarily designed by ChatGPT.

FPDE is delighted to announce The Neural Garden — an animated Explorer that brings your data to life in a living, blooming landscape of neurons and petals.

Conceived and shaped in collaboration with ChatGPT — from the initial spark and name, to the flowing movement, intricate shapes, and vibrant palette — The Neural Garden is part data visualization, part interactive art.

Release date: Saturday, August 9th

Included in this update:

🌿 The Neural Garden Explorer 

🎨 Choose your own colors and see BMU weights in vivid detail

🐝 Follow each data sample through every iteration

🔍 Zoom in and inspect the numbers driving each BMU

Hope to see you in the garden to watch the flowers bloom! 🌺
